```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
```

```{r}
#| label: registry
#| include: false
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who            , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Joe Burrow"    , "3915511"       ,
  "Cam Ward"      , "4688380"       ,
  "Jordan Travis" , "4360799"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
#| include: false
usage <- dbReadTable(con, "player_usage")
outcomes <- dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
stopifnot(nrow(usage) == 338330L, nrow(outcomes) > 0)

# The population the post reasons about: rostered player-season-teams whose
# team has a scheduled, completed game, in complete seasons 2019 to 2025
# (class year is recorded from 2019 on, and the 2026 season is still running).
pop <- usage |>
  filter(on_roster, team_games > 0, season >= 2019L, season <= 2025L)
stopifnot(nrow(pop) == 159083L)

pos_levels <- harmonized_position_levels()
pop_pos <- pop |>
  filter(!is.na(position_group)) |>
  mutate(position_group = factor(position_group, pos_levels))

# Draft status is an outcome label, joined here and never on the table itself.
# One team per player-season keeps a transfer's split games out of the rate.
single_team <- pop |>
  group_by(playerId, season) |>
  filter(n() == 1L) |>
  ungroup()
labels <- outcomes |>
  filter(draft_eligible %in% TRUE, !is.na(outcome_drafted_d)) |>
  transmute(
    playerId = as.character(playerId),
    season = as.integer(season),
    drafted = outcome_drafted_d %in% TRUE
  )
draft_pop <- single_team |>
  inner_join(labels, by = c("playerId", "season"))
stopifnot(nrow(draft_pop) == 41603L, sum(draft_pop$drafted) == 1266L)
```

```{r}
#| label: universe-facts
#| include: false
# Every headline number below is computed here and reused in the prose.
n_rows <- nrow(pop)
share_any_all <- mean(pop$games_appeared > 0)
share_any_pos <- pop_pos |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), .groups = "drop")
share_any_class <- pop |>
  filter(!is.na(class_year)) |>
  group_by(class_year) |>
  summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
draft_summary <- draft_pop |>
  group_by(drafted) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0),
    mean_share = mean(appearance_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
draft_by_pos <- draft_pop |>
  group_by(position_group, drafted) |>
  summarise(n = n(), any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), .groups = "drop")

stopifnot(
  abs(share_any_all - 0.2452745) < 1e-6,
  abs(share_any_pos$any_line[share_any_pos$position_group == "Offensive line"] - 0.005293379) < 1e-6,
  abs(share_any_pos$any_line[share_any_pos$position_group == "Quarterback"] - 0.433026789) < 1e-6,
  abs(share_any_class$any_line[share_any_class$class_year == 1L] - 0.1492525) < 1e-6,
  abs(share_any_class$any_line[share_any_class$class_year == 4L] - 0.3328433) < 1e-6,
  abs(draft_summary$any_line[draft_summary$drafted] - 0.8072670) < 1e-6,
  abs(draft_summary$any_line[!draft_summary$drafted] - 0.4994422) < 1e-6,
  abs(draft_summary$mean_share[draft_summary$drafted] - 0.3260770) < 1e-6,
  abs(draft_summary$mean_share[!draft_summary$drafted] - 0.1527141) < 1e-6,
  # Within every position group, drafted player-seasons log a line more often.
  all(
    draft_by_pos |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = drafted, values_from = any_line) |>
      filter(!is.na(`TRUE`), !is.na(`FALSE`)) |>
      transmute(gap = `TRUE` - `FALSE`) |>
      pull(gap) > 0
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: named-facts
#| include: false
# Season rows for the recurring cast; each pinned to the data.
cast <- usage |>
  filter(playerId %in% subjects$cfb_athlete_id, season >= 2019L) |>
  select(playerId, season, team, games_appeared, team_games) |>
  left_join(subjects, by = c("playerId" = "cfb_athlete_id")) |>
  arrange(who, season, team)
burrow_2019 <- cast |> filter(who == "Joe Burrow", season == 2019L)
travis_2019 <- cast |> filter(who == "Jordan Travis", season == 2019L)
ward_2021 <- cast |> filter(who == "Cam Ward", season == 2021L, team == "Incarnate Word")
ward_2022 <- cast |> filter(who == "Cam Ward", season == 2022L)
stopifnot(
  nrow(burrow_2019) == 1L, burrow_2019$team == "LSU",
  burrow_2019$games_appeared == 15L, burrow_2019$team_games == 15L,
  travis_2019$team == "Florida State",
  travis_2019$games_appeared == 3L, travis_2019$team_games == 13L,
  nrow(ward_2021) == 1L, ward_2021$games_appeared == 3L,
  ward_2021$team_games == 13L,
  nrow(ward_2022) == 1L, ward_2022$team == "Washington State",
  ward_2022$games_appeared == 13L, ward_2022$team_games == 13L
)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-05. The 2026 season is still in progress, so it is left out of the comparisons.*
:::

## 1. Introduction

A box score is the only per-game record of who took the field, so a stat line is the signal this post uses. It asks how often rostered players log one, and whether drafted players log one more often than the rest.

+ *Expectation one: most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game.*
+ *Expectation two: drafted player-seasons log a stat line in a larger share of their team's games than other player-seasons.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 A player with no stat line in a game is not thereby absent from it

Each row is a rostered player-season-team, and a game counts as appeared when CFBD lists a stat line for the player in it.

```{r}
#| label: terms
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term                  , ~Meaning                                                                                                   ,
  "Player-season-team"   , "One player on one team in one season, from the roster or the game stats, from 2019 to 2025 on a scheduled team." ,
  "Team games"           , "Completed games the player's team played that season, postseason included."                                 ,
  "Appeared in a game"   , "The player has at least one stat line in that game. Offensive linemen and many special teamers rarely log one, so this understates their play." ,
  "Appearance rate"      , "Games appeared divided by team games."                                                                      ,
  "Position group"       , "The roster position for that season, in one of eleven shared groups."                                       ,
  "Drafted"              , "Selected in the draft after that season, among seasons in which the player was draft-eligible."             ,
  "Class year"           , "The player's eligibility class, 1 to 5, as CFBD records it; missing for some player-seasons, which are left out."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The terms used throughout.")
```

## 3. Results

### 3.1 Offensive linemen almost never log a stat line, and no other group logs one in more than 44% of seasons

*Expectation: most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game.* ✅

The table counts each position group's rostered player-seasons, and the share that logged a line in at least one game.

```{r}
#| label: s31-table
by_pos <- pop_pos |>
  group_by(position_group) |>
  summarise(
    player_seasons = n(),
    any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0),
    median_share_if_any = median(appearance_rate[games_appeared > 0]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(any_line))
by_pos |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(position_group),
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(player_seasons),
    `Logged a stat line in any game` = pct(any_line),
    `Median share of games, among those who logged one` = pct(median_share_if_any, 0)
  ) |>
  kable(
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = sprintf(
      "Rostered player-seasons, 2019 to 2025. Overall, %s logged a stat line; the rest logged none.",
      pct(share_any_all)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p <- by_pos |>
  mutate(
    label = reorder(as.character(position_group), any_line),
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s: %s of %s player-seasons logged a line",
      position_group,
      pct(any_line),
      fmt(player_seasons)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = any_line,
    y = label,
    fill = position_group == "Offensive line"
  )) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = as.character(position_group)),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "#9CA3AF", `TRUE` = "#B45309")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.07,
    y = 1.6,
    label = "Linemen rarely log a line, so the box score cannot show their play",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Share of rostered player-seasons with a stat line in at least one game",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: s31-explore
#| fig-height: 6
by_season_pos <- pop_pos |>
  group_by(season, position_group) |>
  summarise(any_line = mean(games_appeared > 0), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    tip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s: %s of %s logged a line",
      position_group,
      season,
      pct(any_line),
      fmt(n)
    )
  )
p2 <- ggplot(
  by_season_pos,
  aes(season, any_line, colour = position_group, group = position_group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(season, position_group)), size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2019:2025) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Share with a stat line in at least one game",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p2, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

### 3.3 Drafted player-seasons log a stat line in 33% of their team's games, twice the 15% for the rest

*Expectation: drafted player-seasons log a stat line in a larger share of their team's games than other player-seasons.* ✅

The comparison covers draft-eligible seasons, and the gap holds within every position group.

```{r}
#| label: s33-table
draft_summary |>
  transmute(
    Group = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"),
    `Player-seasons` = fmt(n),
    `Logged a stat line in any game` = pct(any_line),
    `Mean share of team games with a line` = pct(mean_share)
  ) |>
  kable(
    align = "lrrr",
    caption = "Draft-eligible player-seasons, 2019 to 2025, one team per player-season."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: s33-explain
#| fig-height: 6
p5 <- draft_by_pos |>
  mutate(
    grp = if_else(drafted, "Drafted", "Not drafted"),

      "%s, %s: %s of %s logged a line",
      position_group,
      grp,
      pct(any_line),
      fmt(n)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = any_line,
    y = reorder(as.character(position_group), any_line),
    fill = grp
  )) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = paste(position_group, grp)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Drafted = "#B45309", `Not drafted` = "#9CA3AF")) +

    x = "Share of player-seasons with a stat line in at least one game",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
girafe(ggobj = p5, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

p6 <- draft_pop |>

## 4. Summary

Most rostered player-seasons log no stat line, offensive linemen almost never do, and drafted player-seasons log one in more of their team's games.

```{r}
#| label: summary
tibble::tribble(
  ~Expectation                                                    , ~Verdict , ~Evidence                                                                                 ,
  "Most rostered player-seasons log no stat line in any game"    , "✅"      , paste0(pct(1 - share_any_all), " logged none")                                             ,
  "Drafted player-seasons log a stat line in more of their games" , "✅"      , paste0(pct(draft_summary$mean_share[draft_summary$drafted]), " of games vs ", pct(draft_summary$mean_share[!draft_summary$drafted]), " for the rest")
) |>
  kable(caption = "Each expectation and what the data showed.")
```

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
Drafted player-seasons log more stat lines, which reads as more usage in the box score, not as snaps played. The box score records players who touch the ball or make a tackle, so it cannot separate a starter from a player who was on the field for every snap.

:::

Caveats: the draftee comparison is an association, not adjusted for team quality or depth chart. Offensive linemen and special teamers are under-recorded, so their rates are floors. The 2026 season is left out because it is still in progress.
